current_decision.supported_publication_claim: SPPA is a UAV/VR semantic-proxy systems method that converts imperfect detector or tag evidence into lightweight, controllable, metric-aware proxies with favorable runtime/task-fit behavior.
current_decision.first_row_label_policy: Call the first row ground truth only when every displayed item is annotated/reference evidence, not merely a detector crop or a reviewed semantic tag.

external_protocol_context.name: HY3D-Bench
external_protocol_context.why_it_matters: Provides a recent open benchmark/data ecosystem with clean meshes, renderings, sampled points, and part-level data useful for image-to-3D evaluation.

external_protocol_context.name: Hunyuan3D-2.1
external_protocol_context.why_it_matters: Recent open image-to-3D system with full model weights/training code and PBR texture synthesis, so it belongs in any serious contemporary comparison or must be explicitly excluded.

external_protocol_context.name: TRELLIS.2
external_protocol_context.why_it_matters: Recent open 4B-parameter image-to-3D model for high-fidelity PBR textured assets; a 2026-era SOTA comparison should run it or document a hardware/reproducibility exclusion.

external_protocol_context.name: Stable Fast 3D
external_protocol_context.why_it_matters: Fast feed-forward single-image mesh reconstruction baseline with UV unwrapping and material prediction; useful for separating SPPA runtime claims from fast visual reconstruction baselines.

external_protocol_context.name: SPAR3D
external_protocol_context.why_it_matters: Point-aware successor to SF3D with improved backside reconstruction and materials; should be included or explicitly excluded when claiming contemporary image-to-3D coverage.

external_protocol_context.name: P3D-Bench
external_protocol_context.why_it_matters: Recent benchmark framing for parametric 3D generation and structural reasoning, including image-to-3D and part/assembly-level metrics.

input_sets.why_not: All six first-row images are synthetic proxy crops with no detector provenance, no masks, and no reference meshes.

The four real user inputs now have manually reviewed 2D bounding boxes for crop provenance, but none has a segmentation mask, 3D reference mesh, or detector-produced target tag for the requested semantic class.

methods.notes: Must be scored as a runtime semantic-proxy baseline, not as a photorealistic image-to-3D asset generator.
